{{Quote|'''Advantage #7:''' Blast Proof. The LIN Demolitionmech is One Tough Droid|Excerpt from the Demolitionmech's advertising campaign|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer''', commonly known as the '''LIN Demolitionmech''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] marketed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] as a [[Mine/Legends|mine]]-laying and demolitions specialist.

==Characteristics==
[[File:LIN.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An LIN [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]

The LIN droid was equipped with a visual [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and an acoustic signaler that could communicate in the warbling of [[Binary/Legends|Droidspeak]] only. It could be used as a military droid, helping to deploy [[pressure bomb]]s and [[Antirepulsorlift grenade|anti-repulsor grenades]].

The droid was able to move its manipulator arm 360 degrees, so it could both lay mines where it had just been and keep them away from its own heading.<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], LIN droids were used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to clear mines.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also utilized these droids, and many were found in civilian employ.

Cybot Galactica stopped the production of the droid after a charge being held by one of the droids detonated in a mine on [[Gosfambling]]. 10<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> miners died of suffocation in the cave-in. While it was found that the fault lay in the charge, the bad publicity was enough for them to quietly retire the line, though they were made in numerous enough numbers to appear across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], especially in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EGD" />
